name: Wi-Fi access point (kitsune)
description: A kitsune fox that raises an access point: SSID, passphrase, a spoofed BSSID, a channel (fixed or random each wake; 5 GHz on boards that have it), hidden or not, then deep-sleeps on a duty cycle. Hunters find it by SSID or BSSID. Configuration is compiled into the firmware from a conference header; this page prepares, checks and exports that header (docs/kitsune-integration-plan.md). kitsune belongs to its authors: https://github.com/rfhs/kitsune
